decision_detail: governance/lessons/ledger.jsonl (kushin77/agent-orchestrator) is the single writer; kushin77/deepseek's view is derived and read-only; the kushin77/CMR docs/LESSONS.md consolidated index is the second (org-level) derived view, declared but unconfirmed; sync is one-way writer -> derived; peer lessons enter only through a reviewed direction/harvest item carrying provenance, so two symmetric stores can never exist.

no-hub-counterpart.why: No kushin77/CMR index row mirrors this local record: the hub index is org-scoped (its rows span CMR's own issues) while this record is this repository's own artifact. Recording the reason per record is what keeps a local-only listing a judgement rather than a silence.

cmr_hub.local_only_reasons_note: The closed vocabulary a `local-only` declaration in governance/lessons-sync/cmr-ledger.json must draw its reason from. Each reason names a predicate the pass implements; a reason outside this vocabulary, a predicate that is not implemented, or a predicate that no longer holds for the record is reported by id. A declaration also states the hub revision it was judged against (`judged_against`, compared to the freeze's `_provenance.vendor_commit`), so a re-frozen hub invalidates every declaration instead of silently inheriting it, and the ref the record itself carries (`record_ref`), so a declaration cannot be disassociated from the record it covers.
cmr_hub.note: Second lessons ledger: the CMR hub's consolidated index. No mechanical coupling with governance/lessons/ledger.jsonl exists today (no shared record ids, no cross-reference), so this is a DECLARED INTENT, not a confirmed mapping. The frozen baseline is governance/lessons-sync/cmr-ledger.json; every CMR record must carry a disposition (hub-only, or mirrors naming a local counterpart) and a record with none is reported by id. The local side is judged the same way: every local record no hub row mirrors must carry a `local-only` declaration, from the vocabulary above.

hint_transport.local_equivalent: the brain directive recorded in .fleet/sent plus the governance/dispatch claim chain
hint_transport.provenance: every hint carries the lesson id, an issue reference, and a commit sha
